scenes.title: Beneath the political name
scenes.viewerPurpose: Reveal how elections can coexist with unchallengeable power; Name the book's examination beneath labels
scenes.composition: Place an election notice beside an applicant whose complaint has no usable appeal route. Keep the resident and hearing table visible while political labels recede.

scenes.title: Where power can be challenged
scenes.viewerPurpose: Make authority visible through orders, information and consequences; Show why standard democracy/dictatorship comparisons miss variation
scenes.composition: Show who holds the decision record, who holds the information and who receives the complaint. Compare the election notice with the blocked appeal, keeping both conditions true at once.

scenes.title: Before and after the state
scenes.viewerPurpose: Move the history before the state; Connect offices and records to capacity and danger
scenes.composition: Replace the administrative counter with a small gathering before any permanent office exists. Add an office record and a guarded boundary as different capacities, not symbols of inevitable progress.

scenes.title: Learn to see the machinery
scenes.viewerPurpose: Bring the inquiry back to familiar institutions; Point toward the grammar of rule
scenes.composition: Return a familiar request to the review table and leave room for challenge. End with an annotated institutional diagram whose order, information and appeal paths can be examined separately.
